wada.heading: Sanzo Wada, 1883–1967.
wada.roles: Painter. Costume designer. Teacher. Founder of the Japan Standard Color Association, 1927.
wada.volumes: He set down these {{n}} combinations in six volumes, 1933–34. They are still in service.
